metadata.description: The plugins atlas-brief-single uses, each pinned to a release. Generated from plugins.toml by cs-plugin; do not edit.

plugins.name: author-annotation-columns
plugins.description: Find which obs columns hold the authors' own cell-type, tissue, developmental-stage and disease annotations, as opposed to the portal's standardised fields, cluster indices and QC.

plugins.name: onto-mapping
plugins.description: Map annotator-written tissue, cell-type and developmental-stage strings to ontology terms from lexical and graph evidence, with per-ontology advice documents for the conventions that produce confidently wrong answers.

plugins.name: paper-access
plugins.description: Retrieve papers as tagged article XML where it can be had, probe how much of each a search index holds, fetch their supplementary material, and say honestly which papers and files nobody can reach.

plugins.name: remote-h5ad-obs
plugins.description: Read the per-cell obs table out of a remote h5ad over HTTP range requests, without downloading the expression matrix.

plugins.name: atlas-brief-single-set
plugins.description: Installs every plugin atlas-brief-single uses, at the release pinned in plugins.toml. Carries nothing of its own.
